Plugin.Overview:
Monitor and control your Unraid system via REST API, WebSocket, MCP, Prometheus, and MQTT. Supports Docker/VM control, real-time metrics, Home Assistant integration, and AI agent tooling.
Authentication: the API listens on all network interfaces on port 8043 over plain HTTP. Without an API token, anyone on your network can read monitoring data, and every control action (REST and MCP) is refused. Installs upgraded from an earlier version without a token keep control actions working until you set a token; the settings page then asks you to turn that option off. Set a token in Settings, Unraid Management Agent, and use HTTPS when sending it across untrusted networks.
Control scope: with access, the REST API and MCP can reboot or shut down the server, start, stop, update and remove Docker containers, control VMs (including snapshots and clones), start and stop the array, control parity checks, spin disks up and down, and run User Scripts as /bin/bash without a sandbox. MCP read-only mode and tool policies apply to MCP only, not to the REST API.
External lookups: when you request network access URLs, the agent asks api.ipify.org, ifconfig.me and icanhazip.com, in that order, for your WAN IP. Those services see your server's public IP address. Nothing is looked up at startup or on a schedule.
